Fun Time with the Savannah Cat — 1.0.0

Required versions
  Minecraft 26.1.2
  NeoForge 26.1.2.122
  GeckoLib 5.5.2 for NeoForge / Minecraft 26.1.2
  Java 25

Install
  1. Close Minecraft and stop the server. Back up the world before updating.
  2. Use the Minecraft 26.1.2 profile with NeoForge 26.1.2.122.
  3. Put savannahcat-1.0.0.jar and
     geckolib-neoforge-26.1.2-5.5.2.jar in that profile's mods folder.
  4. Install both matching JARs on every client and the dedicated server.
     Keep only one Savannah Cat version in each mods folder.
  5. Launch with Java 25. Open CONFIGURATION.md for server settings and
     BEDTIME.md, HARVEST.md, FAMILY.md, HOME_LIFE.md and AUDIO.md for controls and behavior.

Use the ordinary runtime JAR. Do not install a sources JAR, test mod,
development harness or the project source ZIP in the mods folder.

This Minecraft 26.1.2 port preserves the existing adult/kitten family life,
bedtime, Harvest, responsive Hunt, furniture, fishing, sounds and approved
artwork. Current test results and their limits are in PORT_TESTS_26.1.2.md.
RELEASE_TESTS_2026-10-27.md retains the earlier Minecraft 26.1 evidence.

Audio uses documented, approved vanilla Minecraft recordings.
Fourteen Savannah Cat events and subtitles reference native recordings;
Custom recordings are not required. Adult Susan keeps
her established cue and default pitch. AUDIO.md lists every mapping.

For developers
  Open the source project in IntelliJ as a Gradle project using JDK 25.
  Generate mechanical resources with .\gradlew.bat runData, then build with
  .\gradlew.bat clean build. Runtime output is under build\libs.
  Keep the pinned Minecraft, NeoForge and GeckoLib versions above.
  After updating the live IntelliJ project, reload Gradle once. The client
  run prepares its launch arguments before starting, including after clean.
  The final installed project should also have prepareClientRun completed.

Fresh verification and remaining listening, long-session and external-network
checks are recorded in PORT_TESTS_26.1.2.md. RELEASE_AUDIT.md and
TEST_RESULTS.md preserve older evidence. The isolated development test world
is not a player-world requirement.

Optional JEI
  JEI 29.47.0.110 for Minecraft 26.1.2 / NeoForge is supported.
  Install matching JEI on clients and server for complete multiplayer
  crafting views. Savannah Cat itself runs without JEI.
  JEI is not bundled; see JEI.md and PORT_TESTS_26.1.2.md.

This JAR targets Minecraft 26.1.2. Update the actual launcher profile too.
PORT_26.1.2.md lists required GeckoLib and the inspected profile's
Controlling/Searchables replacements. PORT_TESTS_26.1.2.md is current proof.
